correctness.rationale: For m>=2, the objective is K=3m(tr(L+11^T/(3m))^{-1}-1); strict positive second derivative of trace inverse and injectivity of edge Laplacian entries give a unique unrestricted connected optimum. Budget saturation and permutations within parts and A<->C force the two conductance orbits x>0,y>=0. The full nonzero spectrum is m(x+y) with multiplicity 2(m-1), 2mx with multiplicity m-1, m(x+2y) and 3mx. This proves the displayed K(x,y), with t=y/x and r=P/Q. Differentiating F_m(t) yields F_m prime at zero=r(15m-7)/2-12m, giving deletion iff r>=24m/(15m-7), including the equality/tie case; uniqueness inherited from the original convex optimization. Taylor expansion at r=8/5+κ/m gives mt→max(0,7/6-25κ/16). Independent symbolic derivations and direct full Laplacian spectra matched in 20 instances over m=2,3,4,6. None establishes the infinite m limit without the proof.
